chunks: And in the narration of Al-Sakuni, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, peace be upon him:

That ʿAlī عليه السلام was brought a drinker, so he asked him to recite the Qur'an, and he recited it. Then he took his cloak and cast it among the cloaks of the people, then said to him, 'Pick out your cloak.' So he could not pick it out, and thus he administered the hadd punishment to him.

key_terms.بِشَارِبٍ: a person who had consumed an intoxicant
key_terms.فَاسْتَقْرَأَهُ الْقُرْآنَ: he asked him to recite the Qur'an as a test
key_terms.فَحَدَّهُ: he carried out the prescribed legal punishment upon him

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام determine intoxication before carrying out the hadd punishment?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a judicial procedure of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in assessing intoxication. By testing the man's awareness and discernment, he established the condition warranting the legal punishment for drinking alcohol.
